body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> Following the battle of PDP & LCD TVs, another target of Samsung and LG is their cell phones. From high-end premium phone to DMB phone, Navi phone, and PDA phone, the competition between the two for new feature-rich cell phones is keen.

(Picture 8,9,10,11 : LG’s Navi phone, PDA phone, Roaming phone, Music phone) <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
